text: {"lessons":["My account fell about 22% while I made no trades; holding avoided impulsive reactions, but I should periodically check that my portfolio’s risk and diversification still suit me.","Recent losses do not predict next month’s prices, so I should not sell or buy based on short-term price history alone.","Because losses weigh heavily on me, I should make measured decisions based on my goals and overall portfolio—not trade merely to relieve discomfort or avoid looking at my account."]}
